code-audit.description: Professional code security audit orchestrator covering 55+ vulnerability types across 9 languages. Dispatches one durable agent for each D1-D10 dimension.

git-diff-audit.description: Feature-centric deep incremental security review orchestrator for Git-backed code changes. Supports autonomous, agents, and hybrid engines.

audit-recon.description: Phase 1 reconnaissance agent: tech stack identification, attack surface mapping, module enumeration, authentication chain analysis, and fast exclusion.

audit-d1-injection.description: D1 injection audit agent (sink-driven): SQL/HQL/NoSQL, command injection, SSTI, JNDI, SpEL injection with deep sink chain tracing.

audit-d2-authentication.description: D2 authentication audit agent: login, JWT/token/session chains, MFA/reset flows, anonymous routes and authentication bypass.

audit-d3-authorization.description: D3 authorization audit agent: endpoint permission coverage, role checks, IDOR, resource ownership, CRUD consistency and tenant access.

audit-d4-unsafe-runtime.description: D4 unsafe runtime audit agent: deserialization/gadget chains, native memory corruption, unsafe/FFI boundaries, lifetime and ownership errors.

audit-d5-file-operations.description: D5 file-operation audit agent: upload/download, arbitrary read/write, path traversal, archive extraction, symlinks and temporary files.

audit-d6-ssrf.description: D6 SSRF audit agent: outbound HTTP/RPC, URL parsing, webhook/proxy/image fetch, cloud metadata, protocols and JDBC URL injection.

audit-d7-cryptography.description: D7 cryptography audit agent: key lifecycle, algorithms/modes, KDF, randomness, nonce/IV, password hashing, TLS and certificate validation.

audit-d8-security-config.description: D8 security-configuration audit agent: debug/exposure, CORS/CSP/cookies, error/log leakage, secrets, profiles and compiler/runtime hardening.

audit-d9-business-logic.description: D9 business-logic audit agent: state/value invariants, workflow bypass, race/replay, mass assignment, quotas and tenant consistency.

audit-d10-supply-chain.description: D10 software supply-chain audit agent: dependency manifests/locks, vulnerable versions and reachable APIs, registries, scripts and CI dependency trust.

audit-evaluation.description: Round evaluation agent: coverage gap assessment, three-question rule, sink fan-out check, cross-round transfer structure generation, adaptive round decisions.

audit-verification.description: Per-finding detail agent: independently verifies one database finding, resumes from checkpoints, stores product remediation facts, and generates Chinese Markdown only.

audit-report.description: Report coordinator: dispatches one detail agent per database finding, resumes interrupted runs, and generates Chinese aggregate indexes without duplicating finding bodies.
